b: Dinner was bland, no salt, no spice, just flat..Sing Keeth was worse off than all of us .. The next day he couldn't even remember what he'd eaten

At night they took us fishing and put us in a small boat.. To catch squid you apparently have to jiggle the line up and down.. After standing there a while I understood.. the fish and crabs here are a bit clever… These ones kept casting their lines without a break… In the end one person's hook caught on another's hook.. That's all

Then everyone went to bed… At almost exactly one o'clock everyone came and woke us up… That day was my birthday.. Sing Keeth's too… The two of us were born on the same day in the same hospital… But in character we're opposite poles… This is the third birthday we've celebrated together..

They woke us up with two cakes, and I was terribly sleepy… I just couldn't get up… Then they cut the cake, smeared it on the bed… something happened… I fell asleep again at once.. Only the next morning did I understand a little of what had happened..I've celebrated my birthdays in different places in one way or another… The first time on a ship.. Unforgettable… From before dawn both of us were on the phone.. One after another everyone wished us, we thanked them… It turned out a good day..

That day they said we had to go into some cave, and Mithra and I didn't go… In a little while we'd have to bathe, pack our bags and leave… Hard… So as the three of them set off, she wrapped herself up and went back to sleep… I kept tugging at the bedsheet and all.. It didn't work

When everyone came back and we started packing, that's when we saw yesterday's cake smeared all over… Whatever we did, it wouldn't come off.. We changed the bedsheet and came away, hoping they wouldn't find it until we'd gone..On top of this, when we got the tickets they hadn't taken my share of the money… They told me to pay on the ship.. No one asked on the ship either… These guys said let's just quietly leave it and go… But Mithu and I were the ones who'd put up the Sri Lankan flag and all..Saying it would be no respect for the country, we somehow paid
We got off the ship and began our journey to King Kong country
